{{Quote|You ordered the cream of fleek eel, right? Careful, hon, the plate's hot. And the fleek eels bite.|[[FLO/Legends|FLO]], the WA-7 droid at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]|<ref name="NEGTD" />}}
The '''WA-7 waitress droid''', also called the '''WA-7 service unit''', was a third-degree service [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced by [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]] and [[Utilitech/Legends|Utilitech]] during the [[Mondeo Modernism|Mondeo Modernist]] era.

==Characteristics==
[[File:WA7WaitressProfile-FF64.png|thumb|left|180px|Profile view of a WA-7 waitress droid]]
The design of the WA-7 [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was typical of the era, consisting of streamlined contours, elliptical shapes and whimsical embellishments. The droid was propelled by an effective unipod wheel supported by gyro-balance circuitry. The unipod's drive impellers generated enough power for quick bursts of speed ideal for use within confined spaces such as the floor of a dining establishment. In addition, the droid's design was embellished with a metallic skirt and matching head fins.

==History==
WA-7 units remained in use throughout the [[Mondeo Modernism|Mondeo Modernist]] era and beyond, even into the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By this point, although many still operated as waitresses, some WA-7 units took odd jobs such as courier work, and private collectors even entered a WA-7 team into the [[Nuna-ball/Legends|nuna-ball]] league. The WA-7 players defeated [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.|Serv-O-Droid's]] [[RIC-series general labor droid/Legends|RIC droid]] team in a match in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Another unit was the WA-7 nicknamed "[[FLO/Legends|FLO]]," who operated in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in the last decades of the Republic.
